hints.title: Zero Cost Teleportation
hints.text: Cells with identical uppercase characters allow instantaneous teleportation at zero additional movement cost.

hints.title: One-Time Teleport Exploration
hints.text: Once a teleport letter group has been expanded, mark the entire letter group as processed to avoid redundant cycles.

hints.title: Shortest Path Search
hints.text: Find the shortest path from origin (0, 0) to bottom-right target (m - 1, n - 1), accounting for both unit steps and zero-cost teleports.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Shortest path exploration on grid with zero-cost teleporters.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Repeatedly traversing between teleport portal pairs causes infinite cycles.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Letter-level visited set guarantees each teleportation portal class is expanded at most once.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use 0-1 BFS or Dijkstra with portal group visited deduplication.
